full_prompt_en: A square expressionist oil portrait shows a gaunt mustached man facing almost directly forward against a restless pale background. The face fills the center from near the upper edge to the white collar at the bottom, leaving only narrow margins of surrounding paint. His hair is swept up and outward in dark, irregular tufts that break against the top edge. Large ears flank a long, bony face, and tired green-gray eyes sit deep beneath uneven brows. The nose is narrow and sharply ridged; a thin yellow-brown mustache stretches above tightly closed lips. Cheeks, eye sockets, and jaw are described by many short thick strokes in cream, pink, red-brown, olive green, violet, and gray. These colors touch in jagged patches rather than dissolving into natural skin tone. A dark brown coat surrounds a pale high collar, but the clothing is mostly cropped and partly swallowed by the rough paint around it. The backdrop is a mixture of off-white, faded teal, ocher, and small dark marks. Its brushwork stays as active as the facial surface, though its forms do not resolve into a place. Paint ridges, scrapes, and opaque overlaps make the image strongly tactile. The viewpoint is level and unusually close, so the direct gaze feels intense without any gesture or prop. Light is carried by pale cream and yellow strokes along the forehead, nose, cheek, and collar, while green-brown and violet marks build the hollow shadows. There is no readable text. The overall composition is tense and searching, with a fixed central stare held within a field of restless color and visibly worked pigment.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形表现主义油画人物像里，一位面容消瘦、留着小胡子的男子几乎正面朝向观者，背后是躁动的浅色背景。面孔居中，从接近上边缘一直延至底部白领，周围只余狭窄的颜料边。头发向上和两侧扫成不规则深色发束，在上边缘前破开。大耳朵夹着修长瘦削的脸，疲惫的灰绿眼睛深陷于高低不齐的眉下。鼻梁狭窄且棱线鲜明；细黄棕胡须横在紧闭嘴唇上方。脸颊、眼窝与下颌由奶油、粉红、红棕、橄榄绿、紫和灰色的众多短厚笔触描出。这些颜色以锯齿状小块相接，而非融成自然肤色。深棕外套围住浅色高领，但衣服多被裁去，也部分被周围粗糙颜料吞没。背景由灰白、褪色青绿、赭和小深色痕迹混成。笔触和面部一样活跃，形状却不形成具体地点。颜料棱脊、刮痕与不透明叠涂让画面具有强烈触感。视点平直且异常贴近，因此直接目光即使没有手势或道具也显得强烈。光由额头、鼻、脸颊与领口上的浅奶油和黄色笔触承担，灰绿棕与紫色笔迹建立凹陷阴影。没有可读文字。整体构图紧绷而探寻，固定的中央凝视被躁动颜色与明显经营过的颜料围住。
style_prompt_en: The image has a vigorously worked expressionist oil surface, with short thick strokes, ridges, and scraped overlaps remaining plainly visible. Warm cream, dusty rose, ocher, russet, olive, violet, and faded teal touch in irregular patches, replacing smooth tonal blending with a mosaic of temperature shifts. Edges are jagged and often revised by the next stroke, yet a firm central structure survives the turbulence. Pale marks carry light across selected raised planes; cooler dark pigments settle into hollows and at the margins. The crop presses the main form close to the frame, while the surrounding field stays active but spatially unresolved. Matte heavy paint alternates with thin rough scumbles, creating a tactile rhythm across the whole surface. The overall effect is raw, inward, and emotionally charged, with material and color doing the work of illumination.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有经营强烈的表现主义油画表面，短厚笔触、隆起棱脊与刮擦叠痕都清楚保留。暖奶油、灰玫瑰、赭、赤褐、橄榄、紫与褪色青绿以不规则小块相接，用冷暖变化的拼块代替平滑调子晕染。边缘参差，常被下一笔重新改写，但坚实的中央结构仍在躁动中留存。浅色笔迹把光带过选定凸起平面，较冷深色颜料沉入凹处与边缘。裁切把主体推近画框，周围色域同样活跃，却不确定具体空间。哑光厚颜料与薄而粗糙的干擦交替，在整张表面形成可触节奏。整体效果原始、内向且情绪强烈，由材料与颜色承担照明。
theme_en: A gaunt mustached man painted in broken thick strokes of cream, rose, green, and brown
theme_zh: 一位面容消瘦的蓄须男子，由奶油、玫瑰、绿和棕色厚重碎笔绘成
name: Oskar Kokoschka
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
